scope: Read-only same-SoC ARISC/startup source research; no hardware operations or driver changes

findings.text: sun60iw2p1 ARISC ppu_resume requests policy ON for PPU indices 0..10, but explicitly skips status polling for i==6 with comment do not care ppu gpu core status. A CORE status0 alone is not a vendor-supported failure criterion; this does not prove GPU core power is healthy.

sun60iw2p1 ccu_init configures CPUS/APBS0/APBS1 only. plat_init_early is weak/no-op with no sun60iw2p1 source override. standby_init initializes a wake timer. set_paras is empty, platform_dts_parse_late parses DRAM only. nm of sun60iw2p1 libar100s.a found no GPU/PPU/PCK/startup/plat_init symbol; library contains DRAM save/restore symbols. Closed boot0 behavior is not excluded.
bsp/drivers/pm_domain/gpu_domain.c matches allwinner,gpu-pd, used by sun50iw10p1 5.10/5.15 DTS only in the searched config tree. Its PSW/isolation flow is not evidence for T736.

sun60iw2p1 clock_autogen.h defines CM_GPU0_CFG offset 0x1b24, bit0 mode and bits17:16 status. No code callers were found. T736 and A733 manual register tables omit this item between NPU 0x1b1c and PCIE 0x1b28. Do not use this header alone as justification for a write.

T736 reference-1.txt lines6552..6556: AHB_MAT_CLK_GATING offset0x5c0 GPU0 bit7 default1. lines6647..6651: MBUS_MAT_CLK_GATING offset0x5e0 GPU0 bit16 default1. Passed to clock investigator for actual provider/readback comparison.

No new secure writes, frequencies, reset order or hardware experiments were performed.
